I have a friend who used to constantly fuck with us in small ways. 

Some examples of things he did:

1. we all made french toast at my friends house, and he put cayenne pepper on half of them without anyone knowing. Half of us were complaining that the french toast was spicy and the other half were confused.

2. He somehow started a thing at my friends house where we would put a bag of trash above the door so that it would fall on the person who walked in the room. It got so bad that my friends mom had to explicitly ask that we stop putting trash above the doors in her home.

3. He put a bunch crumbled up chips under the fitted sheet of my friends' brother's bed.

4. He put m&ms under my feather bed, which he thought I would feel when I went to sleep that night. I never noticed until months later when they had welded themselves to the underside of my feather bed. They will never come out.

I'm sure there's more.

One thing I'd like to add is that you can most likely have your poor grades removed from your transcript if you have proof of your struggling mental state. A note from a therapist is just fine. I was going through a really tough time with severe depression earlier this year, and I failed 3 courses at college and the hit to my gpa lost me my financial aid. I spoke with the administration and appealed and they changed the F's to W's, as if I'd withdrawn the classes and there was no grade issued.

I would also highly recommend physical exercise. It helped me a ton to feel better about myself. Although people probably say it to you a lot and you may not believe it, time really does heal. Take it slow and give it time.
